newsitem.title: USA: American Medical stake held by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: American Medical stake held by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it holds a 6.04 percent stake in American Medical Response Inc or 1,474,100 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 261,500 common shares bought between January 10 and January 15 at prices ranging from $39.30 to $39.375 per share.
American Medical, based in Boston, Mass., provides pre-hospital emergency medical care and ambulance services to patients in response to "911" emergency medical calls.
